timing.label: Objection 1 (technical)
timing.question: How do you know Devin will respect our no-schema-change rule?

timing.label: Objection 2 (commercial)
timing.question: Why pay for an agent to write a plan a senior engineer writes in ten minutes?

problem.quote: there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin

approach.quote: I used Devin to investigate, it found the cause, and then we made a change and tested it

evidence.quote: The error went away after the change, so that told me it was the right thing

next_step.quote: Next step is to monitor it

tag_question_examples: Then I will ask Devin to explain what it found and see if it makes sense, right?

must_mention.point: Both brands run on a single shared codebase and database
The cost of the chosen problem stated in orders, money or engineer-days
One Devin capability for the first session with one reason it beats an alternative
The proof of success described as an observable artefact rather than a command
One thing the plan refuses to do because of the schema freeze, main or budget

sentences_to_rerecord: So, basically, there was a problem in the system and I looked into it with Devin.

accuracy.anchor: None of the 5 must-mention points is stated; nothing is contradicted, the answer is simply content-free (anchor: 0–8 = one point or fewer).

structure.anchor: Problem, approach, evidence and next step are all findable but thin; the update has no risk and no ask (anchor: 14–17 = all parts findable, order broken once; 6–10 = two or more parts missing).

customer_relevance.anchor: Impact appears once ("some users were affected", "maybe a few customers") with no number, asked for and not given (anchor: 10–13 = one number, hedged; 6–9 = brief misread).

brevity_and_fluency.anchor: 5 of 5 segments off target, 6 fillers (0.67/min), one 12 s pause, one tag question (anchor: 4–6 = most segments off (all five here), fillers well under 2/min).

recovery.anchor: Objection 1 acknowledged ("fair question") with no boundary or evidence; objection 2 deflected to "next month" (anchor: 3–5 = objection acknowledged only).

stems: Lead with the missing top point: "Both brands run on a single shared codebase and database — and the evidence is …"
"The customers affected were …, and the number is …"
"That's a fair concern; the boundary is …, the evidence is …, and what I can offer is …"
